name: couponmaster
author: Abdul Rahman

sections.description:
couponmaster Free is a complete WordPress plugin for creating, managing, and displaying coupon codes with seamless WooCommerce integration. Whether you’re running an online store or need to manage promotional campaigns, couponmaster Free provides all the tools you need to create and display attractive coupon codes. ALL FEATURES ARE FREE – no premium restrictions, no Freemius integration, everything works out of the box!

Key Features

  • Admin Dashboard – Overview with statistics and quick access to all features
  • Coupon Management – Full CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete) with an intuitive interface
  • Coupon Types – Support for both percentage and fixed amount discounts
  • Usage Limits – Set total usage limits and per-user limits to control coupon distribution
  • Expiry Dates – Set start and end dates for coupons with automatic expiration handling
  • WooCommerce Integration – Automatic sync with WooCommerce coupons for seamless e-commerce functionality
  • Frontend Display – Beautiful coupon cards via shortcode and Gutenberg block
  • Gutenberg Block – Visual block editor support for easy coupon insertion in posts and pages
  • Templates – Clean, professional default coupon template
  • Copy to Clipboard – One-click coupon code copying for better user experience
  • Responsive Design – Works perfectly on all devices – desktop, tablet, and mobile
  • Bulk Coupon Generation – Generate up to 1000 coupons at once (FREE)
  • Analytics & Reporting – Usage statistics, revenue tracking, and CSV export (FREE)

WooCommerce Integration

The plugin automatically syncs coupons with WooCommerce:
* When you create a coupon in couponmaster, it’s automatically created in WooCommerce
* Usage is tracked when orders are completed
* Coupons are validated before being applied at checkout
* Seamless integration with your existing WooCommerce store

Display Options

Display coupons anywhere on your site using:
* Shortcode: [couponmaster code="SAVE20"]
* Gutenberg Block: Visual block editor with dropdown selection

All Features Are Free

This version includes ALL features:
* Bulk Coupon Generation – Generate up to 1000 coupons at once
* Analytics & Reporting – Usage statistics, revenue tracking, and CSV export
* Template Customization – Customize colors and styles via safe, built-in options
sections.installation:
1. Upload the couponmaster folder to /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. The plugin will automatically create the necessary database tables
  4. Go to WP Admin → couponmaster to start creating coupons
sections.faq:
Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes! couponmaster automatically syncs coupons with WooCommerce. When you create a coupon in couponmaster, it’s automatically created in WooCommerce and can be used at checkout.

Can I customize the coupon display?

Yes, you can use the default template. The plugin also supports shortcode attributes to customize the display.

How do I display coupons on my site?

You can display coupons using:
* Shortcode: [couponmaster code="YOURCODE"]
* Gutenberg Block: Search for “couponmaster” in the block editor

Can I set usage limits?

Yes, you can set both total usage limits and per-user limits for each coupon.

Does the plugin work without WooCommerce?

Yes, the plugin works independently, but WooCommerce integration provides enhanced functionality for e-commerce stores.

Are there premium features?

No! All features are completely free. This version includes everything: bulk generation, analytics, and template customization. No premium restrictions, no Freemius integration.

  • Fix: Addressed generic class and option naming (renamed couponmaster_ to couponmaster_).
  • Fix: Resolved fatal error in Bulk Generator.
  • Fix: Removed invalid Plugin URI.
  • Improvement: Enhanced escaping and sanitization across all templates.

  • Full coupon CRUD operations
  • Percentage and fixed amount discount types
  • Usage limits (total and per-user)
  • Expiry date management
  • WooCommerce integration
  • Frontend display with shortcode
  • Gutenberg block support
  • Default coupon template
  • Copy to clipboard functionality
  • Responsive design
  • Settings page for default configurations
